dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Back from Gurabad, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Is there something you need? Things have been quite busy back here with the Tanit...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yes, I heard. She left and went back to that cursed place.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hmph. She was peacocking around the whole time, driving me up the wall... and now she's finally silent. What a relief.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Still, she did help us a great deal... Come to think of it, what do you think she'll find there? And if there's nothing to be found... I wonder if she'll feel lonely... Like how we felt lonely?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's a shame that I couldn't go with you...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Agh, it's nothing major. Can't talk about it right now, though...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's about something within the tribe, and maybe those northerners too. I don't know the details either, to be honest.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Agh. Sorry. The reason I'm acting like this... What I mean to say is... If I...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: No! I—If you meet with danger, then believe me when I say that I'll always be there to help you.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: And if I'm the one in trouble... I believe you'll come for me too, won't you?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Alright... Thanks. You should... keep an eye out for enemies, okay?

choices.text: Of course, but don't forget to pay once I'm done.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hmph... Don't dodge the question with that mercenary talk.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: We're lucky you took that stuff from those northerners. Benben is recovering and looking better already.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Almost as good as when we first met it...

choices.text: Then, when you have the time...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yeah, we'll talk more when I have more time...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's nothing... If you run into any trouble, any danger at all, I'll be right at your side. So... Be careful.
